title: mimid-agent-jmap: test-only ConformanceBackend so crate-jmap's chat_backend_conformance! can run
description: From A4: the testkit macro needs seed access to AgentChat.inner (backend.rs:82), add_account (AgentChat has one fixed account), and a sync constructor; a test crate cannot impl ConformanceBackend for AgentChat (orphan rule). Smallest path: a #[cfg(test)] impl inside mimid-agent-jmap with a stub Agent; about 48/81 tests seed.
